note: Classification must pick from these predefined use cases and pull example_detections verbatim from the matched row. Do not invent new detection lists.

use_cases.name: AI adopters and self-hosted AI
use_cases.description: The companies genuinely running AI in production, including the ones self-hosting models on their own kit.
use_cases.buyer: AI security and governance vendors (e.g. TrendAI, Cranium, Reco, Noma, Straiker, Zenity)

use_cases.name: AppSec and software supply chain
use_cases.description: The companies shipping software on a given stack and tooling, the ones with real dev pipelines.
use_cases.buyer: AppSec / DevSecOps / supply-chain vendors (e.g. Snyk, Veracode, Semgrep, Checkmarx, Chainguard, Black Duck)

use_cases.name: Legacy, self-managed identity
use_cases.description: Companies still on their own directory and self-managed login instead of cloud sign-on. The front door to every SSO, PAM and identity sale.
use_cases.buyer: Identity / IAM / PAM vendors (e.g. 1Password, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Saviynt, Semperis, SpyCloud)

use_cases.name: Firewall and network-gear displacement
use_cases.description: Every company we can see running a given firewall or network brand, by vendor. A switch campaign ready to run.
use_cases.buyer: Network security / SASE vendors and channel (e.g. Fortinet, Zscaler, Check Point, Netskope, Cato, Corelight)

use_cases.name: Cloud security and posture
use_cases.description: Companies by their real cloud footprint and provider mix, read off the estate rather than guessed off a job ad.
use_cases.buyer: CNAPP / CSPM / cloud-workload vendors (e.g. Wiz, Orca, Sysdig, Upwind, Oligo)

use_cases.name: Data security and exposed data stores
use_cases.description: Companies by the data stores and admin surfaces they run: who has databases and object stores worth protecting, and who has left an admin panel showing.
use_cases.buyer: DSPM / DLP / data-security vendors (e.g. Varonis, Cyera, Rubrik, Cohesity, Cyberhaven)

use_cases.name: Endpoint and the under-managed estate
use_cases.description: Estates that look unmanaged: ageing operating systems, remote access wide open, devices sprawling. The managed-takeover list.
use_cases.buyer: Endpoint / EDR, and MDR / MSSP (e.g. SentinelOne, ThreatLocker, Huntress, Rapid7, Arctic Wolf)

use_cases.name: Email and domain security
use_cases.description: Companies by the mail gateway and domain posture they run.
use_cases.buyer: Email security / anti-phishing vendors (e.g. Sublime Security, Mimecast, Proofpoint, Abnormal, Material)

use_cases.name: OT and industrial control
use_cases.description: Companies with internet-visible industrial control systems. Their exact target list, not a guess off an industry code.
use_cases.buyer: OT / cyber-physical security vendors (e.g. Claroty, Dragos, TXOne, OPSWAT, Dispel)

use_cases.name: Machine identity and certificates
use_cases.description: Companies by the certificate and secrets tooling they run, the ones with a renewal problem coming.
use_cases.buyer: PKI / certificate-lifecycle / secrets vendors (e.g. Keyfactor, Smallstep, wolfSSL, Infisical)

use_cases.name: Exposure and attack surface
use_cases.description: Companies with exposed, vulnerable or misconfigured infrastructure. Not yet resolved to companies (observation-level only) — use as a back-pocket talking point, not a hard detection claim.
use_cases.buyer: ASM / vuln management / pentest / BAS vendors (e.g. Qualys, Tenable, Cymulate, Pentera, Axonius, HackerOne)
